meaning: Incident identifier (INCxxxxxxx). Repeated on every event of the incident.
reason: Identifier of the incident.
planned_use: Key to group events, never a feature.

meaning: State of the incident at this event (New, Active, Resolved, Closed, Awaiting ...).
reason: Changes at every event, it follows the progress of the incident.
planned_use: Excluded (leakage). The initial state may be studied later.

meaning: Flag: the record is still active (False once the incident is closed).
reason: Turns False when the incident is closed.

meaning: Number of times the incident was reassigned so far.
reason: Counter that grows while the incident is handled.

meaning: Number of times the incident was reopened so far.
reason: Counter that grows after a resolution.

meaning: Number of times the record was updated so far.
reason: Counter of updates, it grows during the life of the incident.
planned_use: Excluded (leakage). Only used to check the event order.

meaning: Flag: the SLA target was met.
reason: SLA result, linked to how long the incident took.

meaning: Person who reported the incident (anonymised).
reason: The caller exists when the incident is opened.

meaning: Person who opened the incident (anonymised).
reason: The person who opens the incident is known at opening.

meaning: Date and time the incident was opened.
reason: Opening time, start of the target.
planned_use: Start of the target. Time features (hour, weekday).

meaning: User who created the record in the system.
reason: Creation info. Stable, but missing for a large share of incidents.
planned_use: Candidate after checking the missing pattern.

meaning: Date and time the record was created in the system.
reason: Creation info. Stable, but missing for a large share of incidents.

meaning: User who made this update.
reason: Author of each update, changes along the incident.

meaning: Date and time of this update (time of the event).
reason: Time of each update (event time).

meaning: Channel used to report the incident (Phone, Email ...).
reason: Channel used when the incident is reported.

meaning: Location of the caller (anonymised).
reason: Caller location. Rarely changes but can be corrected later.

meaning: Category of the incident (anonymised).
reason: Classification, can be corrected during triage.
planned_use: Candidate. The initial value must be defined.

meaning: Subcategory of the incident (anonymised).
reason: Classification, can be corrected during triage.
planned_use: Candidate. The initial value must be defined.

meaning: Symptom of the incident (anonymised).
reason: Classification, often empty at first.
planned_use: Candidate. The initial value must be defined.

meaning: Configuration item (asset) concerned (anonymised).
reason: Asset concerned. Almost always missing.

meaning: Impact of the incident (1 - High, 2 - Medium, 3 - Low).
reason: Set at opening but can be revised.
planned_use: Candidate. The initial value must be defined.

meaning: Urgency of the incident (1 - High, 2 - Medium, 3 - Low).
reason: Set at opening but can be revised.
planned_use: Candidate. The initial value must be defined.

meaning: Priority, given by impact and urgency.
reason: Given by impact and urgency, can be revised.
planned_use: Candidate. Redundant with impact and urgency.

meaning: Group in charge of the incident at this event.
reason: The group at opening may be known, but it changes during the incident.

meaning: Person in charge of the incident at this event.
reason: Filled while the incident is handled (more often empty on first events).

meaning: Flag: a knowledge-base article is used or linked.
reason: Set when a knowledge article is used to solve the incident.

meaning: Flag: the priority was confirmed.
reason: Confirmation happens during the handling.

meaning: Notification setting (Do Not Notify / Send Email).
reason: Notification setting, stable.
planned_use: Candidate. Check the link with contact_type.

meaning: Linked problem record.
reason: A problem record is linked later. Almost always missing.

meaning: Linked request for change.
reason: A change request is linked later. Almost always missing.

meaning: Vendor involved, if any.
reason: Vendor appears during the handling. Almost always missing.

meaning: Change record that caused the incident, if any.
reason: The cause is known after analysis. Almost always missing.

meaning: Closure code.
reason: Closure information.

meaning: Person who resolved the incident.
reason: Closure information.

meaning: Date and time the incident was resolved.
reason: Resolution time, end of the target.
planned_use: End of the target, never a feature.

meaning: Date and time the incident was closed.
reason: Closure time, after the resolution.
